ns2:section.sectionText: Section Title: Conversations in Mathematics This course is for those who wish to experience mathematics through experimentation, reflection, intuition, and conversation. We will explore a number of provocative, interesting, and important ideas from the canon of mathematics. The goal of this course is to offer the student memorable, lifelong topics of conversations about math. Assessment will be through evaluation of student journal entries. For Chancellor's Scholars only; other may only enroll with the consent of the instructor and the Campus Honors Program.
